description: This file defines the class NumericSprite, which handles rendering numerical values as sprites using OpenGL ES and Android graphics. It includes methods for initialization, rendering, and layout calculations for digit display.

classes.name: NumericSprite
classes.description: A class used for rendering numbers as sprites in an OpenGL ES context, including methods for setup, drawing, and layout calculations.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the sprite with size and label information based on the provided Paint object.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the sprite.

methods.name: roundUpPower2
methods.description: Calculates and returns the smallest power of two greater than or equal to the given integer.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the numeric value to be displayed.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the number sprite at a specified position with given view dimensions.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Calculates and returns the width of the current text in pixels.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Converts an integer value to its string representation.
